title: Turkish Delight Bao
description: A unique Italian dessert fusion of Turkish delight and fluffy bao, perfect for a sweet treat. This Italian dessert combines the softness of bao with the crunch of Turkish delight.
instructions: 2. Roll out the Canadian Bao dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
3. Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
4. Place the dough circles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Bake the dough for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
6. Allow the dough to cool completely before proceeding.
7. Chop the Turkish Delight into small pieces and set aside.
8. In a small bowl, mix together the confectioner's sugar and softened butter until well combined.
9. Add the beaten egg to the sugar mixture and mix until smooth.
10. Assemble the Turkish Delight Bao by spreading a small amount of the sugar mixture onto a cooled bao circle, followed by a few pieces of chopped Turkish Delight.
11. Fold the bao in half to enclose the filling, and serve immediately.
